note: A pooled authored variant yields one pooled HEADER state whose window is the variable's own dates inside the variant's, plus the declared data warning on the name, definition and coding fields.

sources.description: Authored FK register r with no dates, one pooled variant `table` (2020-01-01..2021-12-31) and one variable HEADER (2020-06-01..2021-06-30) with a data warning. Plus the SCB sample.

files.Forsakringskassan/fk.toml:
[[register]]
key = "r"
name = "Register with unknown inception"
[[register.variant]]
key = "table"
name = "Pooled table"
valid_from = "2020-01-01"
valid_to = "2021-12-31"
period_scope = "pooled"
[[register.variable]]
name = "Literal header"
column = "HEADER"
data_type = "text"
data_warning = "Header-only metadata; response codes unavailable."
variants = ["table"]
valid_from = "2020-06-01"
valid_to = "2021-06-30"
